basis: Intellectual disability, neurologic deterioration and hypogammaglobulinemia define syndrome; cleft palate and kyphoscoliosis each annotated 30-79%.
Epilepsy beginning in neonatal or infantile life; no additional organ involvement established across this umbrella.
Congenital intraoral attachment of tongue to palate or maxillary alveolar ridge; oral structures belong to gastrointestinal.
Named syndrome comprises dental enamel hypoplasia, cataract and hydrocephalus; no definition or phenotype frequencies supplied.
Sterile neutrophilic skin ulceration; myositis annotated 80-99%, although clinically unusual. Associated RA, colitis and marrow diseases are separate.
Lipoic acid biosynthesis defect with lactic acidosis and severe encephalopathy; hypertrophic cardiomyopathy reported in 1/1 phenotyped patient; frequency uncertain.
Inherited dentin defect causing generalized tooth weakness and discoloration; hearing loss belongs to a particular subtype.
Neurodegeneration involving motor neurons, parkinsonism and dementia; muscle weakness reflects denervation rather than primary muscle disease.
Thiamine transport disorder with striatal necrosis and polyneuropathy; fixed lower-limb contractures and muscle atrophy each reported in 2/4 patients.
Infection-triggered inflammatory necrotizing encephalopathy; choroid hemorrhage annotated 30-79% supports ocular involvement; respiratory abnormalities may be central.
Congenital clefting of the nose; the pulmonary axis explicitly includes the nose. Associated hypertelorism does not establish eye injury.
Psychiatric trauma-related disorder without defining damage to an organ axis.
Intellectual disability and skeletal findings including short stature and osteopoikilosis define syndrome; renal anomalies are occasional; pigmentation alone is not damage.
Inherited lipoic acid biosynthesis disorder with hyperglycinemia and spastic neurologic disease; optic atrophy and visual impairment annotated 30-79%.
Defining limb malformations, hypospadias involving the urethra, and absent toenails map to skeletal, urinary and nail axes.
Nonspecific chronic inflammation confined to endometrium; reproductive tissue has no axis, and the definition establishes no specific infection or autoimmune mechanism.
Anemia 3/3, leukopenia 2/3 and marrow hypocellularity support blood involvement; otosclerosis 2/2 with hearing loss. Recurrent infections and cholangitis are separate diseases.
Skin fragility and muscular dystrophy define disease; oculomotor palsy/aphasia annotated 80-99%, ocular paresis/ptosis 30-99%; enamel defects omitted at cap.
Umbrella of inherited gamma-glutamyl cycle metabolic defects; no additional organ damage established across the group.
Benign cartilaginous neoplasm arising in joint synovium and impairing joint function.
Defined by neonatal thyroid dysfunction following iodine exposure; hypothyroidism establishes the endocrine axis.
Hereditary glioma susceptibility maps to the CNS tumor site; susceptibility alone does not establish an existing tumor or additional organ damage.
Right ventricular hypertrophy or failure defines the disease; the causative pulmonary disorder is a separate underlying disease.
Melanocytic nevus originates in eyelid skin; skin and eyelids are explicitly covered by dermatologic and ocular axes.
Inherited epidermal barrier disorder causing dry, scaly skin; associated asthma is a separately diagnosed disease and does not establish pulmonary involvement.
